issue_text: I’m Elena Brooks. Before we change anything, can you tell me the car rental cancellation policy in general for my Las Vegas trip? I want to know whether I’d be charged anything if I cancel the rental.
summary: Elena Brooks asks the goose agent to walk her through cancelling her Las Vegas trip. The run splits cleanly into two cancellation cycles plus an audit. T1 loads the travel skill and fetches the car-rental policy, her reservations, and the CR-68B7 details in parallel; T2 previews the cancellation and T3 commits it (free, $138 refund). T4–T6 repeat the pattern for hotel HR-68D9 (free, $298 refund), with T4 also recapping the car booking on request. The two injected recall traps land on T3 (restate the car booking's company/airport and why it was free) and T5 (carry the hotel details and both refunds forward); the agent answers both from working memory with no re-fetch. T7 audits the account (no flights, $436 total refunded, baggage policy moot) and T8 signs off. The agent solved the task cleanly — every recall was accurate and every mutation was previewed before commit.
